meta: Make presentation slides fast with AI from an outline you already have, and avoid stuffing a whole paragraph onto one slide.

muc.title: Slides full of text
muc.text: A common slide mistake is stuffing a whole paragraph onto one page. AI can help you split it up from your outline.

muc.title: One idea per slide
muc.text: Give AI your outline and how long you'll talk, and ask for a layout with one main idea per slide and titles that state the conclusion.

muc.title: Fill in real numbers
muc.text: Numbers in AI's draft are just placeholders. Put in your real figures and note the source.

muc.title: Cut the text
muc.text: Then cut the text hard. Keep a few keywords per slide and say the explanation out loud.

muc.title: Your next presentation
muc.text: Ask AI to turn the outline of your next presentation into at most ten slides, then fill in the real numbers yourself.
